messages.content:
hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

pichuk... interesting name, legend. sounds like you're either from somewhere cool or your parents had a sense of humor.

where you working these days?
Do I need to answer these ?

nah you don't *need* to answer anything. you can just lurk here and watch me be brilliant.

but if you actually want me to find you jobs that pay better than whatever you're doing now... then yeah, i kinda need to know what you're doing now.

up to you boss. i'm here either way.
Find me an sde 2 backend job which pays more than 30 lpa

now we're talking! sde2 backend 30L+... someone knows their worth.

but here's the thing - i can't just magic up roles without knowing if you're actually worth 30L. are you 3 years in at some startup, or 6 years deep at a product company? 

where you working currently? need to see what you're coming from to know what you can get.
I have almost 3 years of experience at a product company
